mapper.insert: INSERT INTO projects (name, repository_url, status, analyzed_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{repositoryUrl}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, repository_url AS "repositoryUrl", status, created_at AS "createdAt", analyzed_at AS "analyzedAt" FROM projects WHERE id = #{projectId}

SELECT sc.id AS "classId", sc.class_name AS "className", sm.id AS "methodId", sm.http_method AS "httpMethod", sm.request_path AS "requestPath", sm.method_name AS "methodName" FROM source_classes sc JOIN source_methods sm ON sm.class_id = sc.id WHERE sc.project_id = #{projectId} AND sc.component_type = 'CONTROLLER' ORDER BY sc.class_name, sm.request_path, sm.method_name
